review_candidates.title: Network System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and proactive Network & System Engineer – Lead with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience to lead and manage our network and IT infrastructure operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing network and system environments while providing technical leadership to the IT support team and managing infrastructure-related projects. Key Responsibilities Lead, manage, and monitor overall network and IT infrastructure to ensure reliability, security, and minimal downtime. Manage and troubleshoot LAN/WAN networks , ensuring stable connectivity and optimal performance. Configure, maintain, and secure routers, switches, firewalls, access points, VPNs, and other network devices . Provide technical support and guidance for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues. Lead and supervise the IT support team , assign tasks, monitor performance, ensure accountability, and follow up on pending issues. Manage and execute IT infrastructure projects , including upgrades, migrations, implementations, expansions, and system improvements. Manage and maintain Windows and Linux environments , including system updates, backups, and routine maintenance. Manage and support virtualization environments including VMware ESXi, vCenter, and Hyper-V . Implement and monitor IT and network security controls , including access management, VPNs, firewalls, and security best practices. Maintain complete and up-to-date IT and network documentation , including network diagrams, configurations, SOPs, asset inventory, and project records. Monitor network and system performance and proactively identify and resolve potential issues. Coordinate with vendors and service providers regarding procurement, maintenance, technical support, and SLAs. Prepare regular IT and infrastructure reports covering system health, incidents, project progress, risks, and recommendations. Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and standardization . Coordinate with management, Operations, and Project teams to ensure technical requirements are delivered effectively. Ensure compliance with company IT policies, security standards, internal controls, and confidentiality requirements. Required Skills & Expertise Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP . Strong hands-on experience with LAN/WAN setup, configuration, and troubleshooting . Proficiency in Cisco networking devices and technologies . Experience with firewall management and VPN configuration . Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems . Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi, vCenter, and Hyper-V . Experience with network and system monitoring tools . Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, network security, backups, and system administration. Strong team leadership and people management skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues and manage multiple priorities. Experience in leading or contributing to IT infrastructure and network projects . Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field . Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Network Engineering, System Administration, or IT Infrastructure Management. Previous experience in a lead, senior, or team supervision role will be preferred. Soft Skills Strong communication and coordination skills. Leadership and team-management capabilities. Analytical and problem-solving mindset. Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Proactive approach toward troubleshooting and infrastructure improvement. Commitment to continuous learning, security, and technical development. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who can take ownership of network and system operations , lead the IT team effectively, proactively identify technical issues, and ensure that infrastructure, systems, and projects are managed efficiently and securely.  Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: Remote Working Hours: 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM PKT   Apply at: recruitment@logicfinder.us

review_candidates.title: IT Support & Network Administrator
review_candidates.company: XL Pro Staffing and Consulting Group
review_candidates.description: XL Pro Staffing & Consulting is seeking an IT Support & Network Administrator to provide hands-on technology support across our office locations. This position will be responsible for supporting employees, troubleshooting computers and office technology, maintaining network equipment, assisting with technology installations, and helping keep our day-to-day IT operations running smoothly. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems and isn't afraid to encounter something they haven't seen before. You don't need to know every answer—you need the technical foundation, curiosity, and initiative to find the answer and follow issues through to resolution . Key Responsibilities Help Desk & Employee Support Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to XL Pro employees. Troubleshoot Windows computers, software, connectivity, login, and account issues. Support Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Install approved software, applications, drivers, and updates. Troubleshoot printers, monitors, docking stations, and other office technology. Provide remote and onsite support as needed. Document solutions and recurring technical issues. Network & Office Technology Maintain and troubleshoot office network equipment, including TP-Link Omada equipment, managed switches, wireless access points, and network connections. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, switch-port, and basic VLAN issues. Install or replace network equipment and assist with network racks and cabling. Coordinate with internet providers, cabling contractors, and technology vendors when necessary. Computers & Hardware Diagnose laptop and desktop hardware issues. Set up, reset, reimage, repair, and prepare computers for employees. Troubleshoot hardware, software, peripherals, and device drivers. Assist with employee technology setup and equipment returns. Maintain and track company IT equipment and assets. Microsoft 365 Support Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft 365. Assist employees with Outlook, Teams, Microsoft Authenticator, MFA, and account issues. Perform authorized basic user administration, license assignments, security-group changes, and mailbox troubleshooting. Onsite & Field IT Support Travel to XL Pro offices and client locations when hands-on technical support is required. Install and troubleshoot computers, printers, network equipment, and other office technology. Install and support company-approved network-connected timekeeping devices at client locations. Assist with office technology moves, upgrades, and new deployments. Cybersecurity & Documentation Follow company cybersecurity and least-privilege practices. Verify required endpoint-security applications are operating properly. Recognize and appropriately escalate suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, or other security concerns. Maintain clear records of troubleshooting, equipment, network changes, installations, and resolutions. Required Qualifications Current CompTIA A+ certification required. 1–2+ years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, network support, or similar experience preferred. Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11. Experience troubleshooting computers, hardware, printers, and peripherals. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365. Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IPv4, DHCP, DNS, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, managed switches, and VLANs. Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and research solutions. Strong communication and customer-service skills. Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical employees. Ability to provide both remote and onsite support. Ability to travel to company offices and client locations as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required : CompTIA Network+ or Security+ Microsoft technical certifications TP-Link Omada or similar managed networking platforms Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Intune or other endpoint-management platforms Microsoft 365 administration Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools Structured cabling and network racks Multi-location IT environments Basic Azure or cloud infrastructure What We're Looking For Technical knowledge is important, but how you approach problems matters just as much . We're looking for someone who takes ownership of issues, asks good questions, researches unfamiliar problems, tests potential solutions, and follows through until the problem is resolved. Hands-on experience counts. Candidates who have built home labs, worked on networking projects, built computers, experimented with virtualization or cloud environments, or pursued other technical projects are encouraged to tell us about them. You don't need to know everything. You do need to be willing and able to figure things out.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase. As an Infrastructure Lead on the Exchange team within Institutional, you'll own the network infrastructure, deployment, and operational tooling behind a unified trading platform that runs across cloud and on-prem/colocated venues. This team powers the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. You'll keep latency-sensitive, multi-node trading environments fast, reliable, and easy to build on, shaping trading infrastructure from the ground up with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase. What you'll do: Own, operate, and optimize resilient, ultra-low-latency networks and physical data-center infrastructure supporting institutional trading, market data, and exchange connectivity across cloud and on-prem environments, including racking, cabling, cross-connects, and vendor coordination. Design and maintain routing, traffic-segmentation, and multicast market-data architectures using BGP, OSPF, VRFs, PIM, IGMP, and high-availability platforms such as Arista MLAG, Cisco vPC, and VRRP. Deploy and operate firewalls and secure connectivity across Fortinet and Palo Alto platforms, including IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and third-party connections. Drive observability and operational excellence through SNMP, gRPC telemetry, latency and packet-loss analysis, microburst detection, and network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Lead safe production changes, incident response, failover testing, and out-of-hours maintenance for 24/7 trading systems, and participate in an on-call rotation. Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with SRE/Infra, Product, and trading-system teams to improve reliability, reduce single-point-of-failure risk, and increase developer velocity. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years of network, infrastructure, or SRE engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production systems in financial services, electronic trading, or another latency-sensitive environment, including on-prem/colocated deployments. Deep hands-on expertise with multicast networking, BGP, OSPF, VRFs, high-availability architectures, low-latency data-center switching, and physical network infrastructure. Proven ability to lead live incident response for production trading systems, manage risk during changes, and coordinate cross-functional resolution during market events. Experience with Fortinet or Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, SNMP or gRPC telemetry, network automation using Python or Ansible, and strong Linux networking fundamentals in latency-critical environments. Familiarity with exchange or electronic trading system concepts; deep crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):: $186,065 USD - $218,900 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial. Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.

review_candidates.title: Lead Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Description Leidos currently has an opening on the ‘Service Management, Integration and Transport’ (SMIT) Contract for a Lead Network Engineer located in Pearl Harbor, Hawaii. Join our team to support the SMIT mission, the largest IT services program for the United States Navy. As part of the Leidos team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering the Navy-Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI) to customers around the globe. We are seeking a highly skilled and solution-focused Lead Network Engineer who will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert across BAN/LAN, Wireless, and WAN/Boundary environments. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust, mature global network and security solutions, including routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, DMZ, and VPN technologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams, domain architects, project managers, automation teams and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) leadership to safeguard our network infrastructure against threats and ensure the highest levels of operational integrity. As a senior member of the technical team, you will manage customer relationships, drive operational processes, and oversee critical resources for Incident Response, Change Management, Problem Management, and DevSecOps initiatives. Primary Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Scope:Lead engineering efforts and collaborate with team members across BAN/LAN, Wireless, and WAN/Boundary architectures. Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expertise:Serve as a cybersecurity SME. Provide technical inputs to cybersecurity topics, including managing STIG vulnerabilities for Cyber Operational Readiness Assessment (CORA) inspections and leading enterprise-wide remediation efforts. Engineering Standards & Governance:Create, modify, and peer-review Engineering Implementation Plans (EIPs). Participate in and present plans at Engineering Review Boards (ERB). Operations & Escalation Support:Provide Tier-III escalation support to the Network Operations Center (NOC) and watch staff. Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex network and security incidents. 24/7 Mission Readiness:Provide 24x7 support on an on-call rotation to resolve critical network issues and meet Navy mission requirements. Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration:Maintain clear, concise, and professional communication with customers, domain architects, project managers, and SRE leadership to align engineering execution with mission goals. Network & Security Administration:Perform highly technical maintenance, performance tuning, and configuration changes on Routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and DMZ appliances. Continuous Service Improvement (CSI):Drive the development of new processes and procedures, write/maintain SOPs/TTPs, and identify network automation opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and reliability. Basic Qualifications Education & Experience:B.S. Degree and 12+ years of prior relevant experience in network engineering. Work experience may be substituted for a degree at the Hiring Manager’s discretion. Security Clearance:U.S. Citizenship with an active DoD Secret security clearance. DoD 8570 Certification:Must currently possess an active DoD 8570.01 IAT Level III Certification (e.g., CCNP Security, CISSP, CASP+, or equivalent). Vendor Certifications:Must currently possess an active Associate-level (or higher) Network Vendor Certification from at least one of the following: Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, or F5 Networks. Technical Breadth:Hands-on experience engineering, troubleshooting, and administering enterprise networks utilizing technologies from multiple vendors, including: Cisco Juniper Palo Alto Networks F5 Networks Brocade Aruba McAfee Gigamon Protocols & Networking Expertise:Extensive experience with routing, switching, MPLS, VPNs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), switching protocols (Spanning Tree Protocol, VLANs, LLDP, VoIP), Multicast, and emerging network technologies. IP Architecture:Deep understanding and in-depth knowledge of IP network/subnet addressing and modern network topologies. Automation & IaC:Hands-on experience with Network Automation tools and principles (e.g., Ansible, Python, Infrastructure as Code). Availability:Ability to work or be called in during off-hours to support critical incident resolution. Must participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience supporting the Navy-Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI) or other large-scale DoD enterprise networks. Strong background in DevSecOps practices applied to network infrastructure. NGEN If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Establish a disciplined governance model across Mythics, Deloitte, Oracle, USDA, and other stakeholders. Provide leadership with timely visibility into delivery risks, financial exposure, customer issues, and subcontractor performance. Work closely with the wider Bertling network to convert international customer relationships into UAE-controlled freight opportunities. Product and vendor capability Strengthen the UAE vendor platform across airfreight, ocean freight, project cargo, road transport, chartering, customs clearance, warehousing and specialist handling. Operate within the Group delegation-of-authority framework and ensure that all significant commitments are properly documented and approved. We offer a British educational curriculum with an international perspective that begins in Nursery and leads up to IGCSE examinations in Year 11, and culminates with the International Baccalaureate Diploma after completing Year 13. We are an inclusive school that invites children from all backgrounds and abilities to participate in the educational offerings on our diverse campus. Founded in 1997 on an attractive, conveniently located site, with excellent facilities and access to local transportation. Today we have more than 2,400 students over a Primary School and High School campus, representing some 68 nationalities ranging from Foundation Stage to Year 13. Our state-of-the-art High School campus (next to Ekkamai BTS) opened in August 2017 giving our students the benefit of world-class teaching and facilities. As part of the NAE family of schools, we are delighted to be able to offer some unique collaborations with world-class establishments, including the Juilliard School of Performing Arts, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), and UNICEF. About The Role At St Andrews, Hebrew is taught as a First Language (native) programme, and we are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Hebrew specialist teacher to join our Languages team. The successful candidate will have experience teaching Hebrew as a native language to Primary and High School students and will play an important role in the development and introduction of a new Hebrew First Language programme at St Andrews. The successful candidate will teach Hebrew First Language to native-speaking students from Year 1 to Year 9. Class sizes are small and students are motivated and enthusiastic, enjoying a lively and engaging approach to learning through a wide range of teaching and learning techniques. The ideal candidate will convey a genuine enthusiasm for the subject and work collaboratively with colleagues to establish and develop a strong, engaging and progressive Hebrew curriculum across Year 1 to Year 9. As this is a new programme, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to its development from the outset. This will include supporting the planning and implementation of the Hebrew First Language curriculum, developing appropriate schemes of work and resources, establishing progression across year groups, and helping to ensure that the programme meets the needs of native Hebrew-speaking students at different stages of their learning. The ideal candidate will have extensive subject knowledge and experience teaching Hebrew using appropriate first-language teaching approaches to native-speaking Primary and High School students. Previous experience teaching Hebrew First Language across multiple Key Stages, particularly from Year 1 to Year 9, is essential. Ensure compliance with company IT policies, security standards, internal controls, and confidentiality requirements. Required Skills & Expertise Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP . Strong hands-on experience with LAN/WAN setup, configuration, and troubleshooting . Proficiency in Cisco networking devices and technologies . Experience with firewall management and VPN configuration . Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems . Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi, vCenter, and Hyper-V . Experience with network and system monitoring tools . Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, network security, backups, and system administration. Strong team leadership and people management skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues and manage multiple priorities. Experience in leading or contributing to IT infrastructure and network projects . Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field . Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Network Engineering, System Administration, or IT Infrastructure Management. Previous experience in a lead, senior, or team supervision role will be preferred. Soft Skills Strong communication and coordination skills. Leadership and team-management capabilities. Analytical and problem-solving mindset. Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Proactive approach toward troubleshooting and infrastructure improvement. Commitment to continuous learning, security, and technical development. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who can take ownership of network and system operations , lead the IT team effectively, proactively identify technical issues, and ensure that infrastructure, systems, and projects are managed efficiently and securely.  Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: Remote Working Hours: 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM PKT   Apply at: recruitment@logicfinder.us

new_matches.description: XL Pro Staffing & Consulting is seeking an IT Support & Network Administrator to provide hands-on technology support across our office locations. This position will be responsible for supporting employees, troubleshooting computers and office technology, maintaining network equipment, assisting with technology installations, and helping keep our day-to-day IT operations running smoothly. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems and isn't afraid to encounter something they haven't seen before. You don't need to know every answer—you need the technical foundation, curiosity, and initiative to find the answer and follow issues through to resolution . Key Responsibilities Help Desk & Employee Support Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to XL Pro employees. Troubleshoot Windows computers, software, connectivity, login, and account issues. Support Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Install approved software, applications, drivers, and updates. Troubleshoot printers, monitors, docking stations, and other office technology. Provide remote and onsite support as needed. Document solutions and recurring technical issues. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, switch-port, and basic VLAN issues. Install or replace network equipment and assist with network racks and cabling. Assist employees with Outlook, Teams, Microsoft Authenticator, MFA, and account issues. Perform authorized basic user administration, license assignments, security-group changes, and mailbox troubleshooting. Onsite & Field IT Support Travel to XL Pro offices and client locations when hands-on technical support is required. Install and troubleshoot computers, printers, network equipment, and other office technology. Install and support company-approved network-connected timekeeping devices at client locations. Assist with office technology moves, upgrades, and new deployments. Cybersecurity & Documentation Follow company cybersecurity and least-privilege practices. Verify required endpoint-security applications are operating properly. Recognize and appropriately escalate suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, or other security concerns. Maintain clear records of troubleshooting, equipment, network changes, installations, and resolutions. Required Qualifications Current CompTIA A+ certification required. 1–2+ years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, network support, or similar experience preferred. Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11. Experience troubleshooting computers, hardware, printers, and peripherals. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365. Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IPv4, DHCP, DNS, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, managed switches, and VLANs. Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and research solutions. Strong communication and customer-service skills. Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical employees. Ability to provide both remote and onsite support. Ability to travel to company offices and client locations as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required : CompTIA Network+ or Security+ Microsoft technical certifications TP-Link Omada or similar managed networking platforms Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Intune or other endpoint-management platforms Microsoft 365 administration Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools Structured cabling and network racks Multi-location IT environments Basic Azure or cloud infrastructure What We're Looking For Technical knowledge is important, but how you approach problems matters just as much . We're looking for someone who takes ownership of issues, asks good questions, researches unfamiliar problems, tests potential solutions, and follows through until the problem is resolved. Hands-on experience counts. Candidates who have built home labs, worked on networking projects, built computers, experimented with virtualization or cloud environments, or pursued other technical projects are encouraged to tell us about them. new_matches.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase. As an Infrastructure Lead on the Exchange team within Institutional, you'll own the network infrastructure, deployment, and operational tooling behind a unified trading platform that runs across cloud and on-prem/colocated venues. This team powers the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. You'll keep latency-sensitive, multi-node trading environments fast, reliable, and easy to build on, shaping trading infrastructure from the ground up with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase. What you'll do: Own, operate, and optimize resilient, ultra-low-latency networks and physical data-center infrastructure supporting institutional trading, market data, and exchange connectivity across cloud and on-prem environments, including racking, cabling, cross-connects, and vendor coordination. Design and maintain routing, traffic-segmentation, and multicast market-data architectures using BGP, OSPF, VRFs, PIM, IGMP, and high-availability platforms such as Arista MLAG, Cisco vPC, and VRRP. Deploy and operate firewalls and secure connectivity across Fortinet and Palo Alto platforms, including IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and third-party connections. Drive observability and operational excellence through SNMP, gRPC telemetry, latency and packet-loss analysis, microburst detection, and network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Lead safe production changes, incident response, failover testing, and out-of-hours maintenance for 24/7 trading systems, and participate in an on-call rotation. Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with SRE/Infra, Product, and trading-system teams to improve reliability, reduce single-point-of-failure risk, and increase developer velocity. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years of network, infrastructure, or SRE engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production systems in financial services, electronic trading, or another latency-sensitive environment, including on-prem/colocated deployments. Deep hands-on expertise with multicast networking, BGP, OSPF, VRFs, high-availability architectures, low-latency data-center switching, and physical network infrastructure. Proven ability to lead live incident response for production trading systems, manage risk during changes, and coordinate cross-functional resolution during market events. Experience with Fortinet or Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, SNMP or gRPC telemetry, network automation using Python or Ansible, and strong Linux networking fundamentals in latency-critical environments. Familiarity with exchange or electronic trading system concepts; deep crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Operations & Escalation Support:Provide Tier-III escalation support to the Network Operations Center (NOC) and watch staff. Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex network and security incidents. 24/7 Mission Readiness:Provide 24x7 support on an on-call rotation to resolve critical network issues and meet Navy mission requirements. Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration:Maintain clear, concise, and professional communication with customers, domain architects, project managers, and SRE leadership to align engineering execution with mission goals. Network & Security Administration:Perform highly technical maintenance, performance tuning, and configuration changes on Routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and DMZ appliances. Continuous Service Improvement (CSI):Drive the development of new processes and procedures, write/maintain SOPs/TTPs, and identify network automation opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and reliability. Basic Qualifications Education & Experience:B.S. Degree and 12+ years of prior relevant experience in network engineering. Work experience may be substituted for a degree at the Hiring Manager’s discretion. Security Clearance:U.S. Citizenship with an active DoD Secret security clearance. DoD 8570 Certification:Must currently possess an active DoD 8570.01 IAT Level III Certification (e.g., CCNP Security, CISSP, CASP+, or equivalent). Vendor Certifications:Must currently possess an active Associate-level (or higher) Network Vendor Certification from at least one of the following: Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, or F5 Networks. Technical Breadth:Hands-on experience engineering, troubleshooting, and administering enterprise networks utilizing technologies from multiple vendors, including: Cisco Juniper Palo Alto Networks F5 Networks Brocade Aruba McAfee Gigamon Protocols & Networking Expertise:Extensive experience with routing, switching, MPLS, VPNs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), switching protocols (Spanning Tree Protocol, VLANs, LLDP, VoIP), Multicast, and emerging network technologies. IP Architecture:Deep understanding and in-depth knowledge of IP network/subnet addressing and modern network topologies. Automation & IaC:Hands-on experience with Network Automation tools and principles (e.g., Ansible, Python, Infrastructure as Code). Availability:Ability to work or be called in during off-hours to support critical incident resolution. Must participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation.
